description: E203. The words of a team's own kind of table. `reasons`: why a declaration was refused, or why a table is not a table of the kind, one closed key each, one sentence each. `quantities`: for each quantity class of the unit registry a kind may name, the label a person reads; the class is what is stored, the label is what every sentence, the command line and the Workspace show, and a declaration may be written with either. `unavailable`: the sentence every kind-of-table request answers until it is served. `refusals` (slice 1): why a request about a kind of table was refused as a whole, one closed key each, one sentence each; a refusal over a table's or a declaration's problems is followed by each problem's sentence. `offline` (slice 1): what the offline check of an exported file says when the table fits, and why it could not check one. Placeholders are in braces; no sentence carries a code.

reasons.column-repeated: Each column of a kind of table is listed once.
reasons.key-not-a-column: Every column of the key must be one of the kind's columns.
reasons.key-may-be-empty: A column of the key must be present in every table and may not be empty.
reasons.quantity-unknown: That quantity is not one the units table knows.
reasons.unit-not-of-quantity: A column's unit must measure the column's quantity.
reasons.quantity-on-text: Only a number column has a quantity and a unit.
reasons.column-missing: The column {column} is needed and is not in this table.
reasons.wrong-type: The column {column} does not hold the kind of value the kind of table asks for.
reasons.empty: The column {column} may not be empty, and row {row} is.
reasons.unit-missing: The column {column} measures {quantity} and this table states no unit for it.
reasons.unit-wrong-dimension: The column {column} is in {unit}, which does not measure {quantity}.
reasons.key-empty: The column {column} is part of the key and row {row} leaves it empty.
reasons.key-repeated: Rows {first} and {second} have the same key; each row needs its own.

unavailable: Kinds of table are not available on this deployment yet.

refusals.kind-unknown: This project has no kind of table called {word}, or not at that version.
refusals.kind-refused: This table is not a {word} table.
refusals.kind-differs: This table is already kept as another kind of table, or as none, so it is not kept again as {word}.
refusals.kind-not-a-table: Only a table kept as a file or a database table linked as a table can be a kind of table.
refusals.kind-moved: The kind of table {word} changed since you read it; it is at version {version} now.
refusals.declaration-refused: This kind of table cannot be declared as written.
refusals.digest-differs: The kind of table written beside this file was changed after it was exported, so the file cannot be checked against it.
refusals.command-reused: That command was already used for another request.
refusals.too-many-kinds: A project has at most 200 kinds of table, and this one has that many already.

offline.fits: This table is a {word} table, as version {version} of the kind declares it.
offline.no-kind: This file carries no kind of table, so it cannot be checked against one.
offline.unreadable: The kind of table written with this file cannot be read, so the file cannot be checked against it.
offline.no-parquet: This computer cannot read Parquet files yet; install the library's folder extra to check one.
